purpose: Describe visible evidence precisely enough to distinguish and retrieve an image; keep source-supported context separate.

dimensions.title: Are the stated details supported?
dimensions.help: Judge what the caption claims, not what it leaves out. A date, place or identity needs source evidence; choose unsure if you cannot verify it. Do not mistake architectural age for photograph date.

options.supported: Supported by the image / supplied evidence
options.unsupported: Contains details the evidence does not establish

dimensions.title: Does it describe the important visual information?
dimensions.help: Look for camera viewpoint, main subjects and their relationships. Do not require every small object or unreadable sign.

options.adequate: Viewpoint and main scene are clear
options.missing_viewpoint: Important viewpoint is missing or unclear
options.missing_subjects: Important subjects or relationships are missing
options.missing_both: Both viewpoint and important scene details are missing

dimensions.title: Would this help distinguish the image in search?
dimensions.help: Does it describe this particular image, or could it fit hundreds of unrelated photos? This is a reviewer assessment; actual retrieval improvement still needs testing.

options.misleading: Would suggest the wrong kind of image

evidence_layers.visual_description: Concise pixel-grounded description: viewpoint, main subjects and distinctive visible relationships. No invented era, mood or historical explanation.
evidence_layers.visual_features: Separate viewpoint, perspective, medium, objects and spatial relationships. Unknown values remain unknown. Every generated field needs provenance and review state.
evidence_layers.source_context: Names, dates, places and attribution remain separately sourced. Do not infer them solely from appearance or silently mix them into visual evidence.

decision_rule: Do not collapse these dimensions into one score. Contradictions need correction; unsupported claims need removal or evidence; missing information needs enrichment; generic wording needs a retrieval test. No automatic publication.
migration: Preserve v1 answers verbatim. Do not infer v2 dimension answers from a v1 overall assessment. Previous sample and baseline scores remain frozen under their original rubric.
